text_block_list.text:
While passing near the dance studio,
I saw Shinko Windy and King Halo
having a lesson.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff...! One, two, three, four...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Practicing alone is boring anyway!
So inviting King... was totally the right call, indeed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: King's dancing was bursting with confidence and so cool! Totally villainous!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?! Wh-who are you calling evil?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"You could totally become a charismatic villain, nanoda!
Won't you join Windy-chan's Evil Legion!?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I can understand your sentiment.
Being first-rate, I would surely rise to the pinnacle of the underworld as well. However—"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's wrong!!
The pinnacle of evil is Demon Lord Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? As a first-rate lady, my talent for villainy is first-rate too!
No one belongs at the top except King!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugah! The most wicked in the whole wide world
is Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Then let's settle this with a dance battle!!
We'll see who's truly the baddest on the dance floor!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I don't mind.
Though it is this King who will be victorious!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll go first...
Here I come—!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmh...! You seem relaxed yet full of confidence—it's the composure of evil! But still!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“—Such sharpness...!
I see, so this is Windy-san's...!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, it's so intense you can't look away!
*This* is the dance of evil!!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright... time for judgment!
Hey, you! Which of us looked badder!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wahaha! A natural outcome!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, it's not like I wanted to be a villain anyway.
I'm not bitter at all!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
King's dancing was amazing too!
You're welcome to be the Demon King's lieutenant anytime!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugahh!? But whyyyyy!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! A King's talent for villainy is truly top-tier!
...Not that I have any intention of turning evil, mind you.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uggh, so frustrating! Next time I'll win for sure!!
I shall reforge my dance of evil!!!

Determined to get revenge on King Halo,
Shinko Windy devoted herself to practicing her dance afterwards.
